# forest_liana

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Forest is a modern admin interface that works on all major web frameworks. forest_liana is the gem that makes Forest admin work on any Rails application (Rails >= 4.0).

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/ForestAdmin/forest-rails
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/forest_liana/9.22.3
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/forest_liana
